annotations.title: Generate a new AI Alert character

description: Requires an approved AlertForge account connection. OAuth-aware clients should start AlertForge's secure authorization flow and ask the user only to sign in and approve. Setup: https://alertforge.ai/ai-agents#agent-setup. Spends credits (the exact price is in list_alert_types' characterGenerateCredits). Generates a brand-new standalone character portrait from a text description via AI -- this is a still image, not a video. Returns a renderId immediately; generation is asynchronous and provider timing varies. Poll get_alert_character_status with it until status is 'completed', then use the returned `path` as characterImageUrl in plan_alert_pack.

prompt.description: A description of the character to generate, up to 600 characters.

name: generate_alert_character
